selection_authority: DPL-14 completed_verified and strict application roadmap order activates MAI after DPL.
objective: Survey the practical map and visual asset ecosystem, formats, licenses/provenance, source classes, and map-vs-World authority boundaries before any canonical MAI schema or importer implementation.

acceptance_profile.ecosystem: Catalog sprite sheets, image collections, autotiles, modular pieces, props/overheads, complete/layered battlemaps, animation, hex/isometric sets and structured editor/VTT exports.
acceptance_profile.format_and_source_classes: Record practical source/format classes and what metadata may be present without treating any vendor/editor as canonical.
acceptance_profile.license_and_provenance: Preserve source/license/provenance requirements and distinguish what may be ingested, transformed, substituted or redistributed.
acceptance_profile.authority_crosswalk: Keep artwork/map resources as projection/presentation rather than World/combat truth; identify owner handoffs and hidden/GM-only visibility boundaries.
acceptance_profile.incomplete_pack_rule: No pack is assumed complete; semantic requirements remain separable from selected art and missing/incompatible assets remain explicit rather than silently invented.
acceptance_profile.validation: Define a focused MAI-01 survey/authority verifier and exact-head repository validation only after a future owner Continue governed-starts this tranche.

nonauthorization: MAI-01 implementation before future owner Continue
silent discard of unsupported structured metadata
World/combat identity inferred from artwork or coordinates
next_action: Next owner Continue must freshly verify then-current canonical AIOC/application heads, re-read the MAI program/backlog and relevant visual/map source evidence, resolve the exact MAI-01 survey/authority evidence set, then governed-start MAI-01 only. Do not create an implementation branch from selected_not_started state.
